scope: Source-only investigation of safe C06/C09/C07 Records approval decisions and owned-fixture cleanup

server_contract.fixture_origin: tests/browser/records-positive-fixture.mjs creates the disposable table and row through authenticated /api/v1/tables REST as the signed-in person; no custom.agent_table_claim is called.
server_contract.approval_gate: RecordStore.record_propose, record_delete and record_restore_version call custom.agent_change_approval for the table. Under default ask, a table not declared by this tool-test conversation's agent can return applied=false, awaiting_approval=true, approval_id.
server_contract.read_and_decide: RecordStore.approval_read calls custom.work_approval_read and exposes pending, approved, declined, withdrawn plus applied IDs. The canonical decision is custom.work_approval_decide(organization_id, approval_id, approve, note).
server_contract.person_authority: aidream packages/matrx-records/tests/test_a_wait_is_a_row_a_person_can_answer.py calls that exact decision door as Actor.person; the store marks agent-origin requests so the person the agent serves may decide.

product_ui_contract.queue: features/approvals/store-door.ts reads custom.work_inbox(NULL) across the person's organizations and custom.work_approval_read for each row's own organization.
product_ui_contract.decision: features/approvals/kinds/store-change.tsx calls decideRecordApproval; features/record-change-approvals/applyRecordChange.ts passes p_organization_id, p_approval_id, p_approve and p_note:null to custom.work_approval_decide through the signed-in person's Supabase client. Approve and Decline are both confirmed decisions.
product_ui_contract.source_test: features/approvals/__tests__/the-store-queue-is-on-the-approvals-page.test.tsx checks both buttons call that RPC and remove only their own queue row.
product_ui_contract.observable_steps: Open the signed-in /approvals page, locate exactly one row by the source-derived id approval-row-store_change-<approval UUID>, verify its Agent change badge and owned-table headline, then click that row's Approve or Decline button. ApprovalQueue opens ConfirmDialog with title 'Approve 1 proposal?' or 'Decline 1 proposal?' and the exact item effect; click the dialog's corresponding 'Approve 1' or 'Decline 1' confirmation. Assert the exact row disappears and the signed-in person's network sent custom.work_approval_decide for that approval ID and owning organization. The source tests' data-testid=confirm belongs only to their mocked dialog, so a native selector must use the real dialog's accessible role/name rather than that test id.
product_ui_contract.direct_rpc_limit: Calling work_approval_decide directly with the person's token could validate the store door and settle cleanup, but it would not prove that /approvals displayed the held change or that the person's confirmation click reached the door.

rpc_response_contract: The held record_propose answer has applied=false, awaiting_approval=true, approval_id, and an approval.reason. work_approval_read returns authoritative state, subject_id, change and applied_record_ids. work_approval_decide approve=true must answer applied=true with record_ids containing exactly the newly written row ID; approve=false answers state=declined, applied=false. These shapes are asserted in aidream packages/matrx-records/tests/test_a_wait_is_a_row_a_person_can_answer.py. A UI success toast or vanished row alone is not write proof.
cleanup_contract: For every case-owned approval_id, read the authoritative approval row and require its organization, subject, change kind, decision state and applied IDs to match the owned table or row. If a mutation cannot continue, the signed-in person must decline that exact pending request through the canonical /approvals decision and re-read state=declined before archival. Store SQL tests show archiving a subject withdraws its pending approval, but archival alone is not proof for every case-owned request; re-read each exact approval and require a nonpending terminal state. An unreadable approval blocks a clean pass.
smallest_runnable_increment: Add a single held C06 record_write on the disposable table, identify its exact approval_id and subject through work_approval_read, approve it by clicking the real signed-in /approvals row and confirmation, require work_approval_decide applied=true with exactly one returned record ID, then read back that ID through the Records tool and check its table/organization/synthetic values. In a finally path, decline only a still-pending exact case-owned approval, re-read its terminal state, archive the table and verify invisibility. Do not proceed to update, restore or delete until this one held→approved→applied path and cleanup are verified.
integration_gap: The current native Records driver operates in the extension Tools card. It has no authenticated /approvals browser navigation, per-approval durable journal, or finally path that decides and re-reads held requests after interruption. A full mutation chain added without those boundaries could leave pending approvals that survive the case or falsely credit an unapplied write. The currently deployed frontend UI revision has not been observed in this source-only task.
